kaiming.title: Kaiming punctuation
kaiming.description: Punctuation fonts for Chinese web typography, with sans-serif and serif styles and variable weights from 100 to 900.
kaiming.rhythmTitle: Refining punctuation rhythm in Chinese text
kaiming.importHint: Precise CSS unicode-range loads and replaces only the included Chinese punctuation.
kaiming.downloadsHint: Use the web fonts directly, or get other formats and build source on GitHub.
kaiming.halfWidthHint: Brackets, quotes, and commas use half-width spacing for a tighter text rhythm.
kaiming.compactHint: Consecutive ending marks are compacted, preserving emphasis without excess spacing.
kaiming.dashHint: Double dashes form a continuous two-character-wide ligature that fits the text.
